XREC001.message: Reconciliation account is not a vendor reconciliation account in this company code
XREC001.why_it_matters: Every posting to the vendor is mirrored to LFB1.AKONT in the general ledger. SAP checks the account type on entry, but loaded or migrated records can point to an account that is missing in the company code or is not a vendor reconciliation account (SKB1.MITKZ = 'K'), so the sub-ledger no longer reconciles.
XREC001.sap_impact: Postings fail or land on the wrong G/L account; the vendor sub-ledger does not reconcile to the G/L.

fix_map.__other__: Set a valid vendor reconciliation account (XK02, company code data; BP in S/4HANA), or correct the account's 'reconciliation account for account type' in FS00.

XREC001.record_fix_template: Vendor company-code record {LFB1.BUKRS}: reconciliation account {LFB1.AKONT} is not a vendor reconciliation account.

MM551.message: Follow-up materials form a loop within a plant
MM551.why_it_matters: Following the follow-up material from record to record must end at a material with no successor. A loop (A to B to A, or longer) means no material in it can receive the requirements.
MM551.sap_impact: MRP follows the chain without end or stops with an error; requirements for every material in the loop are lost.

fix_map.__other__: Break the loop by clearing or correcting one follow-up material in MM02 MRP 4.

MM551.record_fix_template: Material {MARC.MATNR}, plant {MARC.WERKS}: follow-up material {actual_value} is part of a supersession loop.
